definitions.authoring: Freeze first; author and label the complete new question set before executing either retriever. Do not change rules, labels or questions after observing outcomes.

registry_freshness_audit.question: Can artifact-byte checks detect changes missed by indexed-text checks while preserving reproducible prior evidence?
registry_freshness_audit.fixture: Synthetic source envelopes project all ten saved registry records with their metrics and full text; mutations are controlled fault injections, not observations of live source changes.
limitations: Controlled synthetic fault injections, not a live freshness survey or an accuracy estimate. No network refresh or companion experiment was run.

Byte changes include formatting and source metadata: stale means different bytes, not necessarily different scientific results. Unavailable or invalid sources have unknown freshness and block replacement.

Prior registry snapshots retain complete recorded IDs, metrics and evidence text. Original raw sources absent from history cannot be reconstructed; this is reported explicitly. Stored hashes do not authenticate an adversary rewriting both bytes and hashes.
A refreshed registry needs new retrieval protocols and reviewed comparison contracts. Existing frozen inputs are preserved; no compute-cost advantage or model inference is measured.

definitions.authoring: Freeze registry, Python/browser retrieval, comparator and evaluator first. Author and label all questions before either method runs. Seal the manifest and complete questions before evaluation; do not tune rules or labels on outcomes.
definitions.source_recall: Answerable questions only: a labelled acceptable source appears at rank 1 or in the first 3 results.
definitions.source_misses: Answerable questions only at each cutoff: expected source absent; partition into empty retrieval and nonempty wrong-source retrieval. Hits plus misses equal the answerable denominator.
definitions.false_support: Unsupported questions only: any nonempty retrieval, a retrieval-as-support risk proxy, not entailment or generated-answer error.
definitions.empty_retrieval: Report separately for answerable and unsupported questions and each unsupported stratum.
definitions.independence: A new source-aware authored wave, distinct from earlier questions and independent of retrieval parameter selection. Earlier results were visible; no blinded annotator or representative user sampling is claimed.
definitions.costs: Both methods use the same saved title/text and return at most three records. No runtime, operation-count or infrastructure cost advantage is measured.

rows.question: For ordinary market conditions, where does the one-percent loss tail begin in dollars?
rows.rationale: Ordinary conditions refer to the Base market case; the requested loss threshold is its 99% VaR.

rows.question: In the base case, is potential future exposure defined from positive book value or from losses?

anchors.quantum-estimation-lab:risk-1: PFE uses positive future book value, not losses.

rows.rationale: The base-market record explicitly defines the requested exposure quantity.

rows.question: After the volatility shock, what dollar threshold marks the worst one percent of book losses?
rows.rationale: The shock-case VaR is the empirical 99% loss quantile.

rows.question: Under the volatility shock, what is the average loss beyond that tail threshold?
rows.rationale: Expected shortfall is the average empirical tail loss, distinct from VaR and positive exposure.

rows.question: What numerical interval bounds the likelihood estimate of the encoded payoff?
rows.rationale: The quantum oracle record reports these profile-likelihood bounds, with asymptotic limitations.

rows.question: How is the preparation transformation undone inside the probability amplification operator?

anchors.quantum-estimation-lab:amplitude: Householder state preparation is unitary and explicitly inverted inside the Grover operator.

rows.rationale: This describes the simulated oracle construction, not compiled hardware gates.

rows.question: For the eight-asset selection problem, what fraction of samples selects an exact optimum?
rows.rationale: The allocation metric reports optimal-sample probability as a percentage.

rows.question: What classical neighbourhood-search effort reaches the enumerated allocation optimum?
rows.rationale: The allocation source gives both the swap-search result and its neighbour evaluation count.

rows.question: How closely does the variational two-site electron calculation reproduce the reference energy?
rows.rationale: The electron record reports maximum energy error in hopping-energy units.

rows.question: What transformations parameterize the small real state space for the interacting electron pair?

anchors.quantum-optimization-lab:electrons: Three real two-level Givens rotations span the four-state real sector.

rows.rationale: The electron ansatz construction is explicitly described in the frozen record.

rows.question: With equally balanced buying and selling, what uncertainty is reported for the paired policy difference?
rows.rationale: Balanced buying and selling identifies Balanced flow; the requested uncertainty is its standard error.

rows.question: How many cash or position-limit breaches appear when order flow is balanced?
rows.rationale: Position-limit breaches correspond to the recorded cash/inventory violation count in Balanced flow.

rows.question: When order flow is one-sided, what net amount remains after closing the managed position?
rows.rationale: One-sided directional conditions identify Directional market; the amount is measured in synthetic ticks.

rows.question: In a directional market, how far behind symmetric quoting is the managed policy on paired runs?
rows.rationale: The negative paired improvement records underperformance; preserve its sign.

rows.question: With toxic order arrivals, what is the uncertainty of the managed-versus-symmetric difference?
rows.rationale: Toxic arrivals refer to the informed-flow case; its separate standard error is requested.

rows.question: Are any cash or inventory constraints violated in the informed-flow replay?
rows.rationale: The informed-flow record explicitly reports zero violations; this is not proof for every possible run.

rows.question: When conditions remain calm, what is the fixed regressor's average absolute prediction error?
rows.rationale: Calm conditions identify Stable regime and fixed regressor refers to frozen ridge, not expanding ridge.

rows.question: For the stable case, how frequently is the expanding regression fitted again?
rows.rationale: The stable-case method records refitting frequency in observed targets.

rows.question: After the volatility regime break, what error does the periodically refitted regression record?
rows.rationale: The expanding ridge MAE belongs to the regime-break case, not the stable case.

rows.question: Under the regime break, do the saved intervals include even half of the held-out observations?
rows.rationale: Coverage is below half; the low observed value is retained without implying a guarantee.

provenance.data: Four original short source descriptions and four authored evaluation questions
provenance.confirmation: Frozen ten-record artifact registry and 30 new source-aware authored questions; protocol and question hashes are recorded in frozen_retrieval_confirmation.
provenance.independent_confirmation: Second sealed wave: 28 new source-aware authored questions over the unchanged registry and retrieval rules; source misses are partitioned into wrong-source and empty retrieval at each cutoff.
provenance.comparisons: Saved registry metrics and reviewed case-specific dataset, evaluation protocol and quantity contracts; fingerprints and seven measured probes are recorded in compatible_experiment_comparisons.
provenance.freshness: Controlled synthetic source envelopes preserve all ten saved records, metrics and complete text; ten refresh fault injections compare artifact digests with indexed-text checks. Original companion bytes are not reconstructed.

limitations: Small development fixture, not a held-out evaluation or verified full-paper retrieval.
Confirmation source recall and retrieval-based false support use separate denominators; authored questions do not estimate population accuracy or entailment.
Compatible comparisons describe saved synthetic point estimates; reviewed dataset identities are not independently revalidated raw-data hashes and no statistical significance is inferred.
Freshness scenarios are synthetic fault injections, not a survey of current remote source state; exact-byte drift includes formatting changes.
Extractive keyword baseline; no live LLM is called by this benchmark.
Evidence export is separate from any external model-provider integration.
